definitions.price_result: sell notional proceeds minus buy notional outflows over an episode whose observed position starts at zero and returns to zero or reverses; no ending inventory valuation.
definitions.signed_fee_field: API fee field; positive is debit, negative is rebate. Net calculation subtracts this signed field.
definitions.inversion_fee_allocation: A crossing fill is split into abs(pre-position) close quantity and abs(post-position) new-open quantity; fee is allocated proportionally to quantity/notional at the same fill price. This is an explicit allocation assumption, not an exchange-provided split.
definitions.funding_attribution: HYPE userFunding rows with nonzero szi are attributed only when their timestamp falls strictly inside one locally bounded episode. Funding at boundaries, censored tails, or outside a unique episode remains unattributed.
definitions.closedPnl: Raw API field summed separately as an episode fill control. It is not added to or substituted for price flows, fees, or funding; no API/UI equivalence is assumed.
definitions.book_match: Latest BBO/l2Book event strictly before fill event timestamp; no maximum-age cutoff is imposed. Equal-millisecond ordering is unknown; receipt-clock availability relative to exchange fill time is not established.

closedPnl_raw_control.interpretation: Raw API field only; not a reconciled account return.

all_source_fills.method: Latest archived quote with strictly earlier exchange event timestamp; no maximum age filter. Equal-ms order is ambiguous. Cross-clock receipt-to-fill availability cannot be established here.

bounded_episode_fills.method: Latest archived quote with strictly earlier exchange event timestamp; no maximum age filter. Equal-ms order is ambiguous. Cross-clock receipt-to-fill availability cannot be established here.

limitations: REST fill and funding pages are incomplete; local segment coherence does not prove complete history.
Flat-to-flat episodes are dependent events from one account, not independent statistical observations.
Cash-flow price result ignores external capital, any missing fills, inventory at censored boundaries, and mark-to-market of residual positions.
Funding is attributed only to strict interior rows; absent or unmatched funding is unknown, not zero.
Inversion fees are quantity-proportioned because the fill has one price; exchange-level allocation is not observed.
Quote event timestamps can be compared to fill event timestamps; local receipt-clock availability and the clock offset are unknown.
